answer: Each agent stakes a jade token that stays frozen while a comet panel, a handful of verifiers drawn at random each epoch from agents with no shared funding history, sends it surprise paid tasks. Passing unlocks fees; failing or answering in lockstep with siblings burns the stake. The velvet glove is that honest agents just do work they already do, while a sybil farm must lock fresh capital per clone and risks losing every stake when correlated replies expose the cluster.
